tables.title: Payout chase log with days open

tables.title: Direct deposits with balance and due date

tables.title: Booking sources with lead time bucket

tables.title: Fee schedule by channel

tables.title: Local tax lines with check and amount to remit

tables.title: Booking changes with the nights and amount difference

tables.title: Same-day turnovers with hours between stays
tables.hint: One row per day a unit has a check-out and a check-in (a turnover is the clean and reset between two stays): the times and hours between them; days to the date and the tight or roomy check fill in.

tables.title: Long stays with the discount given

tables.title: Booking notes with kind and who handled them

guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the grace days before a payout is chased, the deposit share of a direct booking, the weekly and monthly discounts and the wanted direct share.
Check Units, Channels, Cities and Team. They hold your units, the platform fees and payout days, the local tax percent of each city and the people the other sheets look up.
Enter every stay on Bookings with its channel, dates, rate, cleaning fee, local tax and status. The platform fee, the net payout, the payout date and the net per night calculate themselves.
Enter each payout on Payouts with the expected date and amount and what arrived. Days late, short amount and the chase flag show which payouts need a message today.
Record each chase on Payout Chase Log with the answer received, and each cancellation on Cancellations with the amount kept and the refund.
Keep Direct Deposits for direct bookings: the deposit, the balance and its due date, with overdue balances flagged red.
Use Check-in Calendar for arrivals and Same-Day Turnovers for days with a check-out and a check-in in one unit. Booking Changes and Booking Notes keep the history of each stay.
Read Channel Months and Fee Schedule to see what each channel costs, and Local Tax Lines for the tax collected and the tax the host must remit. Check your own local rules.
Use the 14 calculators for quotes, payout checks, fee comparison, cancellations, double bookings, forecasts, deposits, local tax, long stays and claims.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Bookings Dashboard and Charts every week: bookings, gross, fees, net payouts, cancellations, late payouts and the direct share.

listing.title: Short-Term Rental Bookings Excel Template: Booking Ledger, Platform Fees, Payout Check, Cancellations, Direct Deposits, Local Tax
listing.headline: Know what every booking paid, what is late and what never arrived
listing.description:
Run the booking and payout side of a short-term or vacation rental business in one Excel workbook. Built for a host or co-host with 3 to 15 furnished units rented by the night through booking platforms and direct bookings. The Bookings sheet lists every stay with its channel, dates, nights, guests, nightly rate, room revenue, cleaning fee and local tax, and works out the platform fee, the net payout, the payout date and the net value of each night.

Payouts compares each payout (the money a booking platform sends the host after a stay starts) with its booking and flags the ones that are late, short or missing; Payout Chase Log keeps every message and answer. Cancellations records the amount kept and the refund, Direct Deposits tracks deposits and balances, and Booking Changes and Booking Notes keep the history of each stay. Channel Months and Fee Schedule show what every channel really costs, and Local Tax Lines separates the tax each platform remits from the tax the host must pay over. Check-in Calendar and Same-Day Turnovers show arrivals and the days a check-out and a check-in share one date.

14 calculators cover booking quotes, payout reconciliation, channel fees, cancellation kept amounts, double bookings, occupancy and revenue for a period, an 8-week payout forecast, deposits and balances, local tax, value per night, date changes, long stays, missing payout claims and a direct share grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages to guests, the co-host (a helper who handles guests for a fee), the host, owners and the accountant.

This is part two of the Short-Term Rental Host suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small portfolio to explore first. It helps you keep track of bookings and payouts and does not give legal or tax advice.

documents.title: Missing payout claim letter to a booking platform
paragraphs: Date: {today}. From {set:company} to the booking platform ({col:payouts.channel}). Subject: payout {col:payouts.payout_id} for booking {col:payouts.booking_id}.

The stay of {col:payouts.guest} at {col:payouts.unit} was due to pay out on {col:payouts.expected_date}. The expected amount is {col:payouts.expected_amount} and the amount received is {col:payouts.received_amount}. The payout is {col:payouts.days_late} days late.
We ask you to send the amount of {col:payouts.short_amount} or to explain the difference in writing. Please reply within the usual answer time of the platform.
We keep the booking confirmation and the check-in record as proof.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Monthly booking ledger
paragraphs: Monthly booking ledger of {set:company}, dated {today}, for the month starting {col:seasons.month}. Season: {col:seasons.season}, price factor {col:seasons.price_factor}.
Check-ins in the month: {col:seasons.checkins}. Gross of the month: {col:seasons.gross}, rates before any local tax.
Check every booking of the month against the Payouts sheet and the Local Tax Lines sheet before the books are closed.
The accountant receives this ledger with the payout statements of each channel.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Check-in sheet for the co-host
paragraphs: Check-in sheet of {set:company}, dated {today}. Booking {col:calendar.booking_id}, unit {col:calendar.unit}, channel {col:calendar.channel}.
Guest: {col:calendar.guest}, {col:calendar.guests} guests, {col:calendar.nights} nights. Check-in {col:calendar.check_in} around {col:calendar.arrival_time}. Check-out {col:calendar.check_out}.
Arrival check: {col:calendar.arrival}, {col:calendar.days_to} days to check-in. Send the check-in instructions, confirm the arrival time and note any request on the Booking Notes sheet.
Co-host phone: {col:calendar.cohost_phone}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Booking report for one unit
paragraphs: Booking report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Unit {col:units.unit_id}: {col:units.name} in {col:units.city}, a {col:units.unit_type} with {col:units.bedrooms} bedrooms. Owner: {col:units.owner}.

Last 60 days: {col:units.bookings_60d} bookings, {col:units.nights_60d} nights, gross {col:units.gross_60d}. Platform fees {col:units.fees_60d} ({col:units.fee_share} of gross). Net payout {col:units.net_60d}.
Direct bookings in the last 60 days: {col:units.direct_60d}. Check-ins in the next 30 days: {col:units.next_30d}. Base rate {col:units.base_rate}, cleaning fee {col:units.cleaning_fee}.
The report goes to the owner of the unit with the payout statements.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Channel fee report for one fee
paragraphs: Channel fee report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Channel {col:fees.channel}, fee type {col:fees.fee_type}, applies to: {col:fees.applies_to}.
Percent: {col:fees.pct}, in force since {col:fees.from_date}. Gross of the last 12 months on this channel: {col:fees.gross_12m}.
If the fee applied to all that gross it would cost {col:fees.cost_if_all}. Fee check: {col:fees.fee_flag}.
Review the fee schedule every quarter and compare it with the fees on the payout statements.

Проверьте подразделения, каналы, города и команду. В них хранятся ваши единицы, плата за платформу и дни выплат, процент местного налога в каждом городе и люди, которые указаны в других таблицах.

ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.

ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
